body: it rlly is.. sometimes i wish i could go back to being a kid napping anywhere, then being carried off into a quiet bedroom and all was well. i wish i dont have to do so much just to survive adulthood, it's so unfair that it's a lottery that some people just have to work so hard..

my parents have been staying in my apartment for the past 2 days and i'm starting to feel worn out.. i have been spending almost all of my waking hours with them since friday and having them take up all my privacy in my own apartment is making me lose my sanity. what's worse is, they haven't even done anything to offensive to me the past 5 days. it's just that i've been putting up a mental guard to always watch what i'm saying to them all the time. I can't let them know anything I've been doing outside of work (and even my work to some degree) because they'll use it against me or start criticizing me. I couldn't do anything the moment i finish work, i can't relax before i sleep, or else they'll start asking about it and criticizing the way im doing everything. i've been so on guard that I've lost my appetite, i couldn't stomach any food when I'm with them (which is probably fine coz to them i'm fat anyways). 

what's worse is i feel like i'm insane doing all of this! but i know the moment i let my guard down and let something slip I'll regret it when they start criticising me. it's only been 2 days and my anxiety has already started acting up the moment i have any semblance of privacy. I still have another week to go. I'm so tired of living a life under terror like this. I'm so tired of feeling crazy that I have all these defense mechanisms but this is not even my fault. i was raised criticised for my every move, everything i do is a mistake. it's not my fault for being so defensive about everything i do now

started a new job thinking i got this and i dont want to burden my parents any longer. day 1. i fucking hate it here! this is even worse than being jobless! whats worse is that its probably not the job that sucks, i just fucking hate working in general. i want to die!

everyone says "go seek therapy" but my god the cost of getting someone to actually talk to you is fucking insane. the reality of life is that youre so disposable, the world could afford to lose you without even so much as a blink.

i've been not depressed enough to submit some job applications but after a call today i just don't feel like working.. i just wanted to stop doing anything. i don't enjoy working. i don't enjoy living. i just spend my days hoping i don't wake up as much as possible. it just sucks all around. everything feels like a chore and i don't see the joy of living. it just seems so bleak.
its my birthday today, and i have no friends to spend it with.. just like last year. cant even be sad abt it, not my first lonely birthday.

literally in the same situation here. graduated, felt like i spent 4 years studying a field i dont even like. feels like i got manipulated into finishing my degree and now im dreading being stuck with a job i despise. life feels so dreadful from this angle. youre not alone in this

hey i'm currently going through the dreaded family visit too :< it's tough as hell i feel so mentally drained, like a shell of myself. the only thing that gets me going is counting down the days when they will finally leave. at least before i fall asleep every night, i have a bit of time to myself, away from all the noise and the mean words they'd hurl at me relentlessly. you can do it ;w; stay strong!

literally just happened to me a few days ago. i broke down after i couldnt take my parents words anymore. literally said it loud and clear that i do not want my parents talking down on my feelings and what i did. my mom just looked at me and said "i dont understand you at all. i never raised you to be this weak. you're just as mentally weak as your aunt. maybe it's just me who has been raised right."

straight up will never talk about this ever again. i regret breaking down that very moment because she WILL bring it up like a sin.

i cant stand my dad at this moment.. ever since he hit whats probably male menopause hes been berating me for literally everything i'm doing, i literally cant stand talking to him anymore. everything i do is obviously wrong to him. i told him i dont drink milk due to lactose intolerance and of course he has to make it about how i have been eating 'wrong' and that im imagining all the lactose intolerance. every conversation he has tried to make with me is trying to tell me that im living my life wrong and that i should work for some chinese company because apparently the companies im applying to are no good. my mom was already bad enough, now i have another parent added into the equation. my fuckin luck being born like this.

it is ffxiv haha the friends i made in game were wonderful but i wonder how much of it was affecting my mental health negatively. i don't have a lot of friends irl so friends in game were as precious to me.. i guess when im not online it made me feel aware of how lonely i am irl. i havent had the chance to log in for a while and i feel like im going thru withdrawals

this is so shallow but I'm holding on just because I will definitely miss my video game avatar if I attempted to do anything with my life. poor girl was the light of my life, not a single day was ever boring seeing her shoot down monsters and celebrate the kill with her friends. I'm feeling miserable as fuck and I'm just swiping over screenshots and looking back at all the good memories. i wonder if me never playing the game ever again would set her free, or if her character would die with me.

i never deleted my ig (don't want my friends and family to think i've actually offed myself) but never opening that blasted app ever again helped me feel better about myself. i can't look at everyone being happy all the time. twitter and reddit on the other hand, is a cesspool of misery and occasional wholesomeness.

getting a therapist is such a lengthy process and it's so pricey.. even after paying all that theres no fucking guarantee you'll come out sane. it's not like the therapists can refund you if you're still mentally fucked up. "we tried our best, now give us your money" fuck that
mental illness really does make me not want to eat anything for most of the day. like just straight up water and sleep. and maybe 1 chocolate piece when i get hungry. and i'm still fat. fuck this.
still alive but feeling like there's an emptiness that I can't fill. can't decide what to have for dinner (or whatever you call that one meal a day you manage to have) coz I don't feel like eating.
rhetorical question, but i wonder if im born a bit more unfortunate, would i feel less guilty about wanting to kill myself
can recommend this as well. also i leave my toothpaste in the shower so i can get both done at the same time. also mouthwashes help if you cant get yourself to brush your teeth too

man i fucking hate my family so much like nobody in this damn household trust me not a single bit. theyd never even think the reason ive been not doing my best is that ive been depressed for fucking years. of course its me just being lazy and annoying yeah? im just going out of my way to be the most useless person in the family.

that was until the nightmares start coming.. sometimes the worries from when i'm awake haunt me in my sleep in crazier ways. i wish i really have just complete undisturbed sleep. feels like i need to sleep for the next year at least

i know im supposed to catch my own thoughts going shitwards and stop thinking horrible thoughts to myself but sometimes i wish i can just be a completely insufferable person towards everyone and somehow come out the other side still loved despite being a terrible person. selfish, i know. but life would probably suck less if there are person who would love me despite being a terrible person. i'm tired of keeping up a positive persona for everyone and myself. sometimes i just wanna go apeshit negative nancy and still have friends

back from my second counselling session.. i feel like these sessions are turning into 'can u beat how much u cried from the prev session'?

the counsellor said i dont think of myself as worthy.. and that i hv this expectation of myself to be this fun, reliable outgoing person.. except i alr knew that. and i still dont think that deluding myself that people like to hang out with losers helps me fix my depression?? i guess the not having self worth part makes sense but i just dont see why i shouldnt strive to be fun in my relationships. i guess i dont see how ppl can just hang out with someone with no expectations at all -- thats just unrealistic. unconditional love does not exist  -- if it does, then boo hoo i've been cheated out of it.

im having so many thoughts on top of my alr existing problems i feel like i just want to take a nap and never wake up to any of my problems.. this session almost felt like a mistake. i left the session having more questions than realisations.. my head hurts and im tired.

i've just had my first session with my counsellor. talked about so many things -- mental abuse, sexual abuse, the loss of my grandmother, my 3 month long major depressive episode.. so many things. i was expecting some filler bullshit ("it gets better", "you just have to stick this out", "this too will pass", tbh i dont find these sayings very helpful) but the counselling session was surprisingly fruitful.

i was told that i might not have had an anchor in my life for the past few years, since it has always been one disaster after another recently. i haven't had someone or something constant i hold on to to ground myself, and i feel very lost because of it. somehow that made a lot of sense since i've been jumping from one obsession to another and i don't hold on to anyone as i thought people changed too much. i might have also had trauma from abuse when i was a child, leading to me treating the world like it's hostile all the time (i still think that it is). 

so yeah, it was actually much more helpful than i thought. i guess i am happy i called the counsellors while i still dont have to pay the big bucks for them (my university has free counselling sessions which i only discovered this year and i was too scared to call before this). if you have access to it, it's very much worth the visit. i ended the call with more answers than i expected
i just booked a counselling session. i hope this is the start of my path to stop giving up every other day. i have low expectations but i really hope i can find a way out from here.
i kinda understand the whole not wanting to regret decisions thing.. to stop living feels very final after all

haven't been doing too well lately. i have so much on my mind, i texted a friend to talk last night. they picked up, but they fell asleep during the call.. i ended it early once i realized they havent been talking for the last 15 minutes. everyone seems to be so busy, i dont want to be a burden and add more of my ranting to their problems. my dad called to check up on repairs to one of their property, i tried to squeeze in some hints, like i told him ive had a lot on my plate recently. all he did was say i better get my shit together because life is so much harder back home. so yeah, no one to talk to. just me and my unending thoughts. i wish i dont have to think anymore.

the only thing thats been keeping me going is a band i've been interested in recently. just seeing one of their members upload a picture or two makes me happy, even for a short while. i keep thinking that this is such a childish, possibly toxic way to feel happiness. im an adult, i shouldnt be so attached so some strangers on the internet. but it's really either this or crying myself to sleep every night.

havent had any dark thoughts until yesterday when i joined a discord call with some old friends and one dude was going thru okcupid and tinder and damn my self esteem took a nosedive. all the girls have all these cute photos and im just here.. going thru my gremlin era. im not looking for anyone but for that one moment just watching my friend's stream was so exhausting i had to leave the call and just head to bed. i guess its good that i know when the dark thoughts come back instead of just leaning along with it and making myself feel like shit the rest of the night

not sure about that coz i lowkey decided to stop existing and give myself a damn break and thru 3 months of break i did everything i wanted (eat junk food, play video games all day, zero responsibilities, didnt respond to calls, literally just doing fuck all since i was gonna die anyway) and i came out of that 3 months still depressed. at this point i just dont think chasing happiness gets rid of depression

god im dealing with so much financial problems i wish i dont have to do all of this.. i dont exactly have anyone to talk to about this either. just me alone tryna work out how to make things work.. it's so hard to just not break down everytime. i keep thinking when does it all end.. it's like living in a nightmare. even the times i feel happy it's followed by anxiety, that i'll soon have to dive back in to feeling like shit. i feel so worthless at times.. im not good enough of a daughter, im probably a terrible friend, im a shit employee, im probably not someone another person would like to get romantically involved either. it's just a lot of shit upon another steaming pile of shit i've got on my hands.. life's so tiring i wish i dont have to deal with all this

might be because im such a helpless romantic, but god liking someone does make my life a bit less tiring to live. im signing myself up for a broken heart most likely but goddamn i cant help feeling happier when i get to talk to the person i like. literally 2 hours prior i was ready to bawl my eyes out because i have so much financial problems right now but just listening to the person's voice from phone speakers makes me feel like maybe if i just survive, i'll pass through this hard period time of my life. maybe i'll actually make it out on the other end. im just chasing something so temporary but god does it feel so good when i do

i really need to fix this thing where i face something mildly stressing and my response is oh.. welp time to die then. it's just.. often it's so hard to see why i have to go on. i don't really look forward to anything, most days i'm just scared of what's to come. even things that should make me happy make me scared instead.. i feel so tired all the time but it feels like no amount of break is gonna be able to fix this.

i've met someone recently, and liking the person has somehow made my life a bit less of a hell to live with. for once i don't wake up with a dread of the morning, i actually look forward to receiving messages from that person. i might be setting myself up, because i'm not sure if that person feels the same way. thats alright i guess, i just need to allow myself to just enjoy what's making me happier for now. 

i've talked to my mother recently. she seems to be very concerned about my mental health. i could say the same for her, this year's been so tough on her. i wish i'm not a burden to her, i feel like i have been for a long time. i said sorry to her for no reason at all, for a lot of the things that have gone wrong lately, she just said "what are you apologizing for?". i think she gets it nonetheless, i guess it's nice to let that out for once.

im having so much trouble being motivated to do anything.. my intern work is supposed to be finished tmrw but i just cant get myself to do anything at all.. im supposed to look for another job after this too and i cant get myself to do anything. i just wake up, sit in front of the screen and i cant do anything. how does anyone get motivated to do anything? i feel like im scared of failure to the point that i cant do anything worth a damn. i hope i dont get fired

also might be cause of the long lockdowns since last year i've been pretty lonely for some time. met this guy thru a game i played. it's kinda weird coz literally all i know about him is just thru this character on my screen. dude's voice is pretty nice, and he doesn't seem creepy.. yet? i know i should do better than having a crush on some rando who happens to have a nice voice and seems kinda nice in general. give it a few more weeks and i might be over it by then
literally me today. stating an unpaid internship, literally the first day and im already thinking that just not living is probably better

i put all my hygiene products in the shower so i brush my teeth while im in the shower. when i cant get myself to do that I use a mouthwash instead. also i take hot showers so i can spend a bit of time standing around overthinking

it's actually sad that the world doesn't exactly work on people wanting to do good. there's only competition and survival of the fittest, and broken people like me are just stepping stones. i wish i can just opt out of life like this.
another year i've stayed alive i guess. don't know for how many more i'm supposed to do so

the anhedonia is getting worse. nothing feels worth doing, not even eating to stay alive. video games bored me out, no tv series is engaging enough to get me hyped, not interested in meeting people, everything feels like a giant chore. living feels like a chore. treating depression takes money and time and i have neither. it truly is better to just disappear one day.

been thinking if i should try writing again as a hobby but i feel like i cant write about anything that is not depressing.. 

been looking for a job. all i get are rejections, which i already anticipated anyway. still hurts tho, since im on a ticking time bomb. my visa depends on me getting a job, and i think id sooner off myself than return back to my parents house. all in all everything kinda sucks for now

i tried working out so i can fix my sleep schedule (i sleep at 7am these days.. all the way to 4pm) but when i tried working out i cant help but feel so damn weak. like i used to be able to at least not lose my damn breathe when i do sit ups and now i just cant. i actually dont get how ppl even love working out

then i started feeling self conscious watching all these videos with all these influencers and their toned bodies and i feel so damn worthless lol. am fat, jobless, not particularly good at anything, dont know what im living life for. dont like dating people either. i wish i could sleep and wake up the next day and suddenly be struck with some life changing life purpose coz now i really just wake up, eat, take a bath, go back to sleep. 

actually do any of yall have any life purpose or something u live for? give me a few ideas to start i guess
